title: Ethvixity Pack
description: This texture pack is customized for Ethvixity and what you see in his videos
body:
🔥 Ethvixity Pack – Clean PvP Essentials 🔥

Dominate every fight with the Ethvixity Pack, a fully customized PvP texture pack built for smooth gameplay, better visibility, and clean aesthetics.

This pack includes all the essentials you need to win more fights and react faster:

⚔️ Low Fire – See clearly even when you’re burning
🛡️ Low Shield – Improved visibility while blocking
💥 Cleaner Particles – Less visual clutter during combat
🎯 Optimized Textures – Designed for better focus and performance
✨ Custom Style – Unique look made specifically for Ethvixity

Whether you’re grinding ranked, playing SMP, or clutching fights, this pack gives you the competitive edge without sacrificing style.
